purpose: Normal local component comparisons and deadline regressions; no public campaign or input-generation workflow.

comparison.per_round_ratio: sum(candidate thread CPU) / sum(reference thread CPU)
comparison.p95_definition: ascending round ratios, nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), n=16; no confidence or population-tail claim
comparison.required_outcomes: Every planned call must complete with the same legitimate result and original progress/read denominator; missing CPU clock, failed call or missing sample prevents qualification.
comparison.decision: Retain a development component only if both fixed timing conditions and all applicable semantic controls pass; otherwise retain the patch and raw negative evidence and restore the prior production implementation.

host_component.inputs: Two current procfs texts and five valid temporary limit files; original whole-file helpers and error semantics.
host_component.reference: Parent source File::open paths and original numeric parser
host_component.candidate: Prepared immutable CStr names with fresh opens and current-byte exact comparison/fallback

account_graph_component.reference: Frozen parent prepared-single reader; the older per-node Vec oracle is correctness evidence only
account_graph_component.candidate: One sibling-pair query per fork, all current rows and original progress checks retained

scope_limits: These are component observations, not an independently built whole-node comparison.
They cannot close the original four-second service gate, resource-isolation qualification, public participation, or W1 cost/hardness gates.
No resource, absolute deadline, target, required-work or confirmation threshold changes.
No throughput, causal end-to-end speedup, GPU/ASIC competitiveness, storage lifetime or model efficacy inference.
